settings.depth_null: every chunk of the pass is queued
settings.chunk_time: interval on the card between the events after consecutive chunks, idle time between launches included
settings.desktop_load: a working desktop. Utilization, memory and core clock are read before and after every round of a case

note: One card, one machine, one model. No pass goes stale and no pass runs inside the worker. Nothing here is a latency bound.
